title: Item 3 · Taking a payment — four ways today
subtitle: Approved in each section — not a mistake. Each way was signed off on its own: Star's dialog (v0.109, your point that “someone may register cash and pay by check or card”), Color Belt's one click (v0.136, which replaced a dialog you had approved earlier), Camps copying Color Belt and then moving it into a box on the “$ due” tag (v0.709, v0.715), and Black Belt's dialog for payment plans (v0.218). The question: should one way be used everywhere? (Preview screenshots at PC size · fake data · mockup amounts)

items.caption: 1. Color Belt — one click. “Mark paid” records the full price with the method the family chose earlier (“Paying by”). Nothing is shown before it saves; the toast says “Ava Chen marked paid · $50 cash”. If they pay another way, staff must first use ⋯ → Change how they'll pay.
2. Camps — tap the “$245 due” tag, then “Mark paid” in a small box. The box shows the amount but not how they're paying.

row.caption: 3. Star — a dialog: Paid by (set to the family's choice), Amount, Date paid, then Save.
4. Black Belt — a bigger dialog: which payment of the plan (“For”), Amount, “Method” (a different word), a note, and “Save and record another”.

columns.label: Proposed (option C) · one small box

items.caption: 5. Color Belt: “Mark paid” opens a small box: the amount, Paid by already set to what the family chose (here Check), then “Mark paid $50”. Two taps; he sees what will be recorded before it's saved.
6. Camps: the box it already has, plus Paid by.

row.caption: 7. Star: “Record payment” becomes the same “Mark paid” and box.
8. Black Belt keeps its dialog (payment plans need “For”), with the same word: Paid by.

columns.note: Copies what's already there: Camps' box, Star's “Paid by” buttons and hint (“They chose Check on the form.”), Color Belt's “Mark paid” button. Drawn over the real pages; nothing in the app was changed.

footer:
Your choice — one question:
A · Keep the four ways (all approved); change only the words (“Paid by” everywhere, every toast says amount and method). + no rework. − the Grandmaster learns four ways; in Color Belt and Camps a family paying differently still needs a trip to ⋯ first.
B · One click everywhere (Color Belt's way): Star's dialog and Camps' tag become a one-click “Mark paid”; Black Belt keeps its dialog. + fastest, 1 tap. − it saves without showing what; a different method still needs ⋯ first; Star loses the choice you asked for in v0.109.
C · Recommended: the same small box everywhere (right side). + 2 taps; amount and method are shown before anything is saved, like writing the receipt; a different method is one tap in the same box; one look in Color Belt, Star and Camps. − one more tap than Color Belt today; a different amount or date (Star's dialog allows both now) is fixed afterwards with Edit payment by an admin.
In every option Black Belt keeps its dialog for payment plans. Next, item 3b: receipts — does the desk hand out paper receipts today?
